Refactored the SQL completion contexts around a shared base so the neutral/default behavior lives in one place instead of being reimplemented across LSP, UI, and test code. The new model-layer base is [AbstractSQLCompletionContext](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G001_dbeaver/plugins/org.jkiss.dbeaver.model.sql/src/org/jkiss/dbeaver/model/sql/completion/AbstractSQLCompletionContext.java:32), and the test-side counterpart is [SQLCompletionTestContext](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G001_dbeaver/test/org.jkiss.dbeaver.test.platform/src/org/jkiss/dbeaver/model/sql/completion/SQLCompletionTestContext.java:27). That let me collapse a few hundred lines of duplicated getters/default flags/proposal creation.

Downstream contexts are now smaller and more focused: [LspSQLCompletionContext](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G001_dbeaver/plugins/org.jkiss.dbeaver.model.lsp/src/org/jkiss/dbeaver/model/lsp/context/LspSQLCompletionContext.java:29) only keeps its LSP-specific `showValues` behavior and resolves its preference store once at construction, while [SQLEditorCompletionContext](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G001_dbeaver/plugins/org.jkiss.dbeaver.ui.editors.sql/src/org/jkiss/dbeaver/ui/editors/sql/syntax/SQLEditorCompletionContext.java:36) now inherits the shared structural fields and only overrides editor-specific preference behavior and proposal creation. I also replaced the ad hoc test contexts in [RequestResult](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G001_dbeaver/test/org.jkiss.dbeaver.test.platform/src/org/jkiss/dbeaver/model/sql/analyzer/builder/request/RequestResult.java:133), [SQLCompletionRequestFactoryTest](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G001_dbeaver/test/org.jkiss.dbeaver.test.platform/src/org/jkiss/dbeaver/model/sql/completion/SQLCompletionRequestFactoryTest.java:65), and [SQLCompletionProposalProviderTest](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G001_dbeaver/test/org.jkiss.dbeaver.test.platform/src/org/jkiss/dbeaver/model/sql/completion/SQLCompletionProposalProviderTest.java:76). The proposal-provider test was also fixed to the current API, which now reads preferences from the request context instead of a separate argument.
